origin.basis: Schwalbe is the brand of Ralf Bohle GmbH, Reichshof, Germany (legal notice).

manufacturing.basis: The Schwalbe product pages do not state where the tire is made.

availability.note: Schwalbe's European and North American sites give recommended retail prices and send buyers to retailers; mainland China availability not verified.

name: Pro One Allroad
positioning: Allroad Pro One with a V-Guard belt for mixed road and gravel riding.
caveats: Maximum pressure is 4.5 bar (65 psi) in every size.
Schwalbe states no hookless approval on these product pages.

price_observations.conditions: Recommended retail price on the official product page on 2026-11-01; one tire; retailer prices vary.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-03 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list in a browser (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out.
